name: Vectara
description: Vectara offers advanced AI-driven solutions for natural language processing and understanding, enabling businesses to enhance their customer interactions and data insights.

events.d: Runs when new corpora are created within the last specified number of minutes.
Creates a new Vectara corpus to store documents for search and retrieval.
Retrieve corpora, with optional filter, corpus IDs, result limit, and pagination key.
Delete a corpus by its key. Configure the corpus key and optional request timeout headers.
Update a corpus using only provided fields (enabled, name, description, save query history) and optional timeout headers.
Retrieve documents from a chosen corpus; set corpus key, limit, metadata filter, page key, or request timeout.
Permanently delete a document from a specified corpus by document ID; optionally set request timeout headers.
Initiates an asynchronous bulk metadata update for documents in a corpus.
Creates a Vectara user with optional API, corpus, and agent roles.
List users with optional corpus filtering, pagination (limit and page key), and request timeouts.
Update a user's enabled state, API/agent/corpus roles, description, or metadata by selecting fields to change.
Creates a new AI agent with a model, steps and optional tools.
Lists all agents or searches them by filter, with optional paging.
